limitations: Machine-assisted author review, not separate peer review, human academic certification or a real incident closure.

All Cedar inputs, control probabilities, losses, resources, legal declarations and policy limits are invented instructional assumptions. No empirical effectiveness or probability of a tail event is established.

Queue model has one entity/currency, funded equal-amount single-slot jobs and window-level timing; no intrawindow sequencing, preemption, route eligibility, settlement finality, behavioral arrivals, borrowed cash or actual provider availability.
Irrecoverable bank-borne duplicate/unknown/premature loss is a stipulated accounting convention; real discharge, recovery, reporting and mandate conclusions require scoped facts and qualified review.
Control independence holds only outside the common branch; coverage is independent of the stated states. Selective bypass, changed severity or adaptive behavior requires a different law.
All-green metadata and numeric gates mean eligibility for independent review only; they do not authenticate staff, legal authority, build artifacts, logs or cyber security.
